messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@marketsoft.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MarketSoft renewal — token economics & route additions

Hi Alyssa — great to chat today. Quick recap and next steps from our side so we can align on the renewal and route/add-on asks:

- Current baseline: ~350M tokens/month (mostly text-gen + some embeddings).
- MarketSoft goal: support a product initiative that pushes to ~1.2B tokens/month within 9–12 months (mainly increased chat volume and a new summarization route).
- New routes: 2 additional model routes planned — a smaller Llama-compat route for low-latency chat and a higher-quality 8k context route for long-form summarization.
- Ops ask: stronger SLAs for peak traffic windows and a formal canary plan for the new route.
- Budget guidance you gave on the call: target range centered around $1k / 1M tokens (flexible +/- 20%) depending on blend and reservation options.

What I need from you to get a firm commercial proposal and pricing bands:
1) Confirmation of the 1.2B target and expected ramp (months 0, 3, 6, 12 breakouts).
2) Prioritization of the two new routes (which is must-have at launch vs later).
3) Any procurement constraints (PO timing, auto-renewal, preferred billing cadence).

I attached a one-page worksheet to capture the ramp and a draft SOW outline. If you can return that by Thu 6/17, we'll build a blended renewal model and a reserve-capacity option for predictable latency.

Thanks — enjoyed the conversation.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: MarketSoft_Token_Econ_Worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet), MS_Renewal_SOW_v1.3.pdf (SOW draft)

Thanks Rafael — handy summary, appreciate it. Quick confirmations inline: 

- 1.2B target: yes, that’s our internal planning target by month 12. Ramp we expect: month0=350M (current), month3=500M, month6=800M, month12=1.2B.
- Route priority: must-have at launch = low-latency chat (smaller model route). Summarization route (8k context) is high priority but can be phased in month 3–4.
- Procurement: standard PO, annual contract preferred; finance needs an indicative $/1M number to include in the budget submission next week.

On budget: target band of $1k / 1M is the internal benchmark; if you can show a blended path closer to $900–1,050 / 1M with reserved capacity options that would be favorable.

I’ll fill and return the worksheet by Wed 6/16 EOD.

Cheers,
Alyssa Chen
Director, Product Ops | MarketSoft

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@marketsoft.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MarketSoft renewal — token economics & route additions

Alyssa — thanks for the fast turnaround and the ramp numbers. Attached is a quick two-option commercial outline and a worked example (MarketSoft_Token_Econ_Worksheet.xlsx updated). Highlights below: 

Option A — Blended renewal (no reservation)
- List per-1M token rates:
  • Low-latency route (smaller model): $1,250 / 1M
  • Summarization 8k route: $1,750 / 1M
  • Embeddings and misc: $850 / 1M
- Example blended results for their ramp (month0=350M, m3=500M, m6=800M, m12=1.2B):
  • Month0 blended ~$1,030 / 1M
  • Month12 blended ~$980 / 1M (because more traffic shifted to the low-latency cheaper route)
- No SLA uplift; standard hosted SLAs apply.

Option B — 12mo renewal + reserved capacity for low-latency route
- Reserved pricing for low-latency route when committing to a 6+ month reserved block (predictable capacity): $950 / 1M effective on committed volume.
- Uncommitted traffic priced at list for other routes.
- With a 30% commit on month12 expected volume (360M of the 1.2B) the blended effective $/1M drops to ~$900 on the overall consumption for month12 in the worked example.
- SLA uplift: we can offer a 99.9% p95 latency target on reserved pool during peak windows (addendum in SOW).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Rafael — send the worksheet back with Alyssa's final ramp confirmation when you get it.
2) Alyssa — if finance wants the indicative number now, the easiest callout is Option B with a 30% reservation — that lands them near $900 / 1M in month12.
3) If they want lower blended economics, we can propose larger reservation % or an annual committed tier that steps pricing down further (we’ll run scenarios).

I attached the updated worksheet and the SOW stub. Happy to jump on a call Wed if they want a line-by-line.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Commercial Pricing | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
